items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: It had a nucleus, it was Bill Chase, Sal, myself and Nat and Chuck and that’s all we had.

ctx.x: No he was 22. I was listening to some old Woody Herman things we did in 1962. Sal Nestico was 22 years old then too. Boy was he wailing. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
